llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Notion sync utility that uses a Notion token and local markdown files in ways that match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Network access is hard-coded to api.notion.com, credentials are sourced from NOTION_API_KEY, and file operations are restricted to the current working directory by default with an explicit unsafe override.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill includes executable Node.js scripts and requires node, but no npm dependencies or install-time execution were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions disclose NOTION_API_KEY use, api.notion.com access, local file reads/writes, page archiving, batch updates, and monitoring state; batch updates require a filter or explicit stdin IDs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to a documented watch state JSON file in the workspace by default or a user-specified state path; no services, hooks, schedulers, or background workers are installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The scripts search, query, create, update, archive, import, export, and monitor Notion pages/databases, which is coherent with the stated bi-directional Notion sync purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable granting a Notion integration token access to the pages and databases you share with it. Use a secret manager or OpenClaw protected secret bound to api.notion.com, avoid pasting tokens into chat or commands, and review batch updates or archive commands before running them.
llm.findings: [LP3] expected: The Notion API key and outbound Notion access are necessary for this skill. Although the manifest is minimal, the artifact repeatedly discloses the credential workflow, recommends protected host binding to api.notion.com, and the code uses that host directly.
